hypothesis.claim: A causally closed, tape-isolated local-32 Byte-LSTM update can preserve exact P/K identity and produce target-scale finite-archive gain over both the qualified q1 parent and a frozen 16-event target-rotation control.
hypothesis.falsification: Any valid 1MB F archive gain below 4,080 bytes, any valid 10MB F archive gain below 40,793 bytes, or any valid scope where F does not strictly beat S falsifies target-scale causal value; implementation, dependency, inverse, repeat, package, or resource failures produce no scientific verdict.

changedMechanism: Add exactly one persistent all-Byte-LSTM local-32 update at causal closure phases 32/96, after the closure byte is parent-coded, then rebuild only recurrent dynamic state through a native-tape-isolated replay. No predictor family, parameter subset, optimizer constant, horizon, population, or mixture is varied.
invariants: P/K/F/S use one future content-addressed source tree, binary, frontend, coder, population, compile profile, and ordinary parent update cadence.
The source-defined forward window is x_s..x_(s+31), its exact causal targets are x_(s+1)..x_(s+32), and the first adapted prediction is for x_(s+33).
Byte x_(s+32) is always coded by the parent distribution produced before the midpoint update and is never recoded or reinterpreted as adapted evidence.
The midpoint backward path uses detached local-32 errors, adjoints, and gradients and cannot overwrite ordinary 128-event training tape rows.
F/S preserve the actual pre-replay hidden feature for the ordinary pending output update associated with x_(s+32).
K performs the full detached update arithmetic and unchanged-parameter state-only replay but leaves every future-affecting live value exactly equal to P.
F/S commit one recurrent Adam step and one output SGD step in donor order and refresh the same fp16 shadows as the source parent.
The later ordinary 128-event update retains its source call site and executes the frozen current-boundary approximation over mixed-version history; no hidden correction is introduced.
S rotates exactly the 32 closure targets by 16 positions and changes no other semantic or computational axis.
All oracle evidence receives zero objective credit and cannot be added to another candidate's gain.
